question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the option that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48cc8bf1934a010e8366181d70554577caebfa24503c788d55e53f21ab07df51.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8b38f6bd2b848a7ea3797aba622a36effff280a5ad4feb27018882509af3494.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d8d69e828d30f8d0ccd7dab74cf6ea151342925eb1a3b2b8524e625120d950.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a96b6bdaf97a1801d2723ce0ea93c84461a0e4b5f62506513db0a9dfc3977d15.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42df3238ef57c992c3c2caad4fd76382ce03e4aef19dcfd75056cf2538dc2d7a.png] ⇒ 3; 1; 3; 2

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/977379df4124e2c87b67722029ed0fadf2625f4d782eb81c648b3f83724f91dc.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8b38f6bd2b848a7ea3797aba622a36effff280a5ad4feb27018882509af3494.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d8d69e828d30f8d0ccd7dab74cf6ea151342925eb1a3b2b8524e625120d950.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a96b6bdaf97a1801d2723ce0ea93c84461a0e4b5f62506513db0a9dfc3977d15.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42df3238ef57c992c3c2caad4fd76382ce03e4aef19dcfd75056cf2538dc2d7a.png] ⇒ 1; 3; 2; 3

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28ae7dac7215638f85b0ed489c95b51c33b8a75cc4924fe776cf119f32ff5f33.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8b38f6bd2b848a7ea3797aba622a36effff280a5ad4feb27018882509af3494.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d8d69e828d30f8d0ccd7dab74cf6ea151342925eb1a3b2b8524e625120d950.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a96b6bdaf97a1801d2723ce0ea93c84461a0e4b5f62506513db0a9dfc3977d15.png] ; [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42df3238ef57c992c3c2caad4fd76382ce03e4aef19dcfd75056cf2538dc2d7a.png] ⇒ **2; 2; 3; 2**

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
